correctness.rationale: For diagonal D=diag(1,a,b,c), abc(a²−b)(b²−ac)(ab−c)≠0, the secant/tangent congruences of the standard twisted cubic C and D(C) are closed Veronese P² surfaces in Gr(2,4) via dual Plücker P(A,B,C)=(C²,−BC,AC,B²−AC,−AB,A²). Comparing P with appropriately scaled Q gives a finite intersection. In chart A=U=1 elimination gives C=−(δ/ε)B² and B³=0; at B=V=1 gives A²=C²=0 and uniquely determined Plücker scale; the reverse chart gives another B³=0. Thus the only support points are the shared endpoint tangent lines and the cross-endpoint proper secant, with local Artin rings lengths 3,4,3, total cycle degree ten. Independently built the six Plücker equations and Gröbner eliminated all three projective charts for two rational diagonal triples; standard-monomial counts were 3,4,3. These specializations corroborate the symbolic uniform proof, not replace it.
residual_risks: Only generic diagonal parameters satisfying three stated nonvanishing relations; exceptional diagonal strata not classified.
Two of the three support lines are shared tangents, so the result is not ten distinct proper common secants.
